name: Potion of Poison
description:
This concoction looks, smells, and tastes like a Potion of Healing or another beneficial potion. How-
ever, it is actually poison masked by illusion magic. Identify reveals its true nature.
If you drink this potion, you take 4d6 Poison damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.
